title: 架构：可靠性、安全与可观测性

examples.en: We treat the API contract as a promise, so any breaking change needs a new version.
examples.zh: 我们把接口契约当成一种承诺，任何破坏性变更都要出新版本。

situation.zh: 面试官问：两个团队并行开发，怎么避免联调时才发现接口对不上？
situation.en: We agree on the API contract up front, and both sides build against it.

entries.note: 用测试来保证调用方和提供方都遵守契约，叫 contract testing。

entries.zh: 给接口做版本管理（动词短语）

examples.en: We version the API in the URL path, so v1 clients are unaffected when we ship v2.
examples.zh: 我们在 URL 路径里给接口做版本管理，所以上线 v2 时 v1 的客户端不受影响。

situation.zh: 面试官问：接口需要做不兼容的改动，但老客户端还在用，怎么办？
situation.en: We version the API. The old version keeps running until clients have migrated to the new one.

entries.note: 名词说法是 API versioning。
collocations: support two versions side by side

entries.zh: 拆分单体应用（动词短语）

examples.en: We decided to break up the monolith because deployments had become slow and risky.
examples.zh: 我们决定拆分单体应用，因为部署已经变得又慢又有风险。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你在上家公司做过的最大的架构改造是什么？
situation.en: I led the effort to break up the monolith, starting with the billing module.

entries.note: monolith 读 /ˈmɑːnəlɪθ/，重音在第一个音节。形容词 monolithic：a monolithic application。
collocations: extract a service from the monolith

examples.en: We used the strangler fig pattern, routing one endpoint at a time to the new service.
examples.zh: 我们用了绞杀者模式，一次把一个接口的流量切到新服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：老系统不能停，你怎么一步步把它替换掉？
situation.en: I'd apply the strangler fig pattern: put a proxy in front, then move functionality over piece by piece until the old system can be retired.

entries.note: 也常简称 strangler pattern。

examples.en: We drew the service boundaries around business domains instead of technical layers.
examples.zh: 我们按业务领域而不是技术分层来划分服务边界。

situation.zh: 面试官问：拆微服务的时候，最难的是什么？
situation.en: Getting the service boundaries right. If two services always change together, the boundary is in the wrong place.

examples.en: We pulled off a zero-downtime migration by running both databases in parallel for two weeks.
examples.zh: 我们让两个数据库并行跑了两周，实现了零停机迁移。

situation.zh: 面试官问：换数据库的时候，业务停了多久？
situation.en: It was a zero-downtime migration. We copied the data in the background and cut over one service at a time.

entries.note: 切换那一下叫 cutover，动词是 cut over。
collocations: cut over to the new system

examples.en: After adding the new column, we ran a script to backfill it for existing rows.
examples.zh: 加了新列之后，我们跑了个脚本为已有的行回填数据。

situation.zh: 同事问：新字段上线了，但老数据这一列都是空的，怎么办？
situation.en: I'll backfill the old records in batches overnight so we don't overload the database.

entries.note: 也可以作名词：run a backfill。

entries.zh: （分批）推出、上线（动词短语，r 开头）

examples.en: We rolled out the change to ten percent of users and watched the metrics for a day.
examples.zh: 我们先把这个改动推给 10% 的用户，观察了一天指标。

situation.zh: 经理问：新的搜索功能什么时候所有人都能用上？
situation.en: We'll roll it out gradually this week and reach everyone by Friday if nothing breaks.

entries.note: 名词连写 rollout：a gradual rollout、a staged rollout。

entries.zh: 弃用（标记为不推荐使用）

examples.en: We deprecated the v1 endpoints last year and plan to remove them in March.
examples.zh: 我们去年就把 v1 的接口标记为弃用了，计划三月份下线。

situation.zh: 面试官问：旧接口不想再维护了，你会直接删掉吗？
situation.en: No, I'd deprecate it first, give clients a migration window, and remove it once traffic drops to zero.

entries.note: deprecate 是“不推荐再用，但还能用”；真正下线说 remove、retire 或 sunset。

entries.zh: 紧急开关（一键关停功能）

examples.en: We added a kill switch so we can disable the feature without redeploying.
examples.zh: 我们加了一个紧急开关，这样不用重新部署就能关掉这个功能。

situation.zh: 面试官问：新功能如果把下游打挂了，你最快的止损手段是什么？
situation.en: We ship every risky feature with a kill switch, so anyone on call can turn it off in seconds.

entries.zh: 舱壁隔离（模式名，一个词）

examples.en: We use bulkheads, giving each dependency its own thread pool, so one slow service can't starve the others.
examples.zh: 我们用了舱壁隔离，给每个依赖单独的线程池，这样一个慢服务不会把其他依赖的资源占光。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个下游变慢，把所有线程都占满了，怎么避免？
situation.en: I'd apply the bulkhead pattern and isolate resources per dependency, so the damage stays contained.

entries.note: 原意是船舱之间的隔板，一个舱进水不会让整条船沉掉。常说 the bulkhead pattern。

entries.zh: 退而使用…（备用方案，动词短语）

examples.en: If the pricing service times out, we fall back to the last known price.
examples.zh: 如果定价服务超时，我们就退而使用最后一次已知的价格。

situation.zh: 面试官问：实时汇率接口挂了，下单页面怎么办？
situation.en: We fall back to a rate we fetched earlier and flag the order for review.

entries.note: 名词连写 fallback：a fallback response。

examples.en: It's better to fail fast and return an error than to keep the user waiting for thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 与其让用户干等三十秒，不如快速失败、直接返回错误。

situation.zh: 面试官问：下游已经明显不可用了，请求还要不要排队等？
situation.en: No, we should fail fast. Queuing more requests just makes recovery harder.

entries.zh: 加随机抖动（让重试时间错开）

examples.en: We add jitter to the retry delay so that clients don't all retry at the same moment.
examples.zh: 我们给重试间隔加了随机抖动，这样客户端不会在同一时刻一起重试。

situation.zh: 同事问：所有客户端都按 1 秒、2 秒、4 秒的间隔重试，会有什么问题？
situation.en: They'll all come back in waves. We should add jitter to spread the retries out.

examples.en: In a distributed system you have to design for partial failure, not just total outages.
examples.zh: 在分布式系统里，你必须针对部分失败做设计，而不只是考虑整体宕机。

situation.zh: 面试官问：一个批量接口处理 100 条，其中 3 条没成功，你怎么返回？
situation.en: I'd treat it as a partial failure: return the 97 successes and list the three failed items so the client can retry them.

examples.en: We practice chaos engineering by killing random instances in production during business hours.
examples.zh: 我们实践混沌工程的方式，是在工作时间随机杀掉生产环境的实例。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么验证故障转移真的管用，而不是只停留在设计文档里？
situation.en: We run chaos engineering experiments, like shutting down a zone, and check that the system recovers by itself.

entries.note: chaos 读 /ˈkeɪɑːs/，ch 发 /k/。

entries.zh: 故障模式（系统可能出错的方式）

examples.en: Before the design review, I listed every failure mode I could think of and how we'd handle each.
examples.zh: 设计评审之前，我把能想到的每一种故障模式都列了出来，以及各自怎么应对。

situation.zh: 评审时你想问对方：这个新组件可能会以哪些方式出问题？
situation.en: What are the failure modes here? For example, what happens if the disk fills up or the network drops?

examples.en: Our disaster recovery plan assumes we could lose an entire region and still restore service within an hour.
examples.zh: 我们的容灾方案假设整个区域都可能丢失，并且仍要在一小时内恢复服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：如果整个机房被毁了，你们多久能恢复？数据会丢多少？
situation.en: Our disaster recovery targets are an RTO of one hour and an RPO of five minutes, and we test them twice a year.

entries.note: 缩写 DR。RTO 是允许的最长恢复时间，RPO 是允许丢失的最长数据时间窗口。

examples.en: We implemented graceful shutdown, so in-flight requests finish before the process exits.
examples.zh: 我们实现了优雅停机，进程退出前会先把处理中的请求跑完。

situation.zh: 同事问：为什么每次发版都有几个请求报 502？
situation.en: The service doesn't do a graceful shutdown. It should stop accepting new requests and drain existing ones first.

entries.note: 动词说法是 shut down gracefully；把现有连接处理完叫 drain connections。

examples.en: The outage got worse because every client retried at once and caused a retry storm.
examples.zh: 故障之所以恶化，是因为所有客户端同时重试，引发了重试风暴。

situation.zh: 面试官问：重试不是能提高成功率吗，有什么坏处？
situation.en: Naive retries can cause a retry storm, where the extra load keeps a recovering service from coming back up.

entries.zh: 升级（把问题上报给更合适的人）

examples.en: I couldn't find the cause within twenty minutes, so I escalated to the database team.
examples.zh: 我二十分钟内没找到原因，所以把问题升级给了数据库团队。

situation.zh: 你值班时遇到一个自己搞不定的故障。你在群里说：
situation.en: This is beyond what I can fix alone, so I'm going to escalate to the platform team.

entries.note: 及物、不及物都可以：escalate the issue、escalate to someone。名词 escalation：an escalation policy。

examples.en: I got paged at 3 a.m. because the disk on the primary database was almost full.
examples.zh: 我凌晨三点被告警叫起来，因为主库的磁盘快满了。

situation.zh: 同事问：你昨晚怎么没睡好？
situation.en: I got paged twice last night for the same flaky alert.

entries.note: page 作动词是“呼叫值班的人”：page the on-call engineer。只有需要人立刻处理的告警才应该 page。

entries.zh: 宣布进入事故状态（动词短语）

examples.en: As soon as checkout errors passed one percent, I declared an incident and opened a channel.
examples.zh: 结账错误率一超过 1%，我就宣布进入事故状态，并拉了一个频道。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你发现线上有大面积报错，第一步做什么？
situation.en: I'd declare an incident right away, so the right people get pulled in and customers get an update.

entries.note: 事故按严重程度分级，常说 a SEV1 或 a P0 incident。负责总协调的人叫 incident commander。

entries.zh: 应急操作手册（r 开头）

examples.en: Every alert links to a runbook that explains what to check and how to mitigate.
examples.zh: 每条告警都链接到一份应急操作手册，说明该查什么、怎么缓解。

situation.zh: 新同事问：我第一次值班，半夜告警响了不知道怎么处理怎么办？
situation.en: Follow the runbook linked in the alert. It walks you through the steps one by one.

entries.note: 也有团队叫 playbook。

examples.en: Automated rollbacks cut our mean time to recovery from forty minutes to under ten.
examples.zh: 自动回滚把我们的平均恢复时间从四十分钟降到了十分钟以内。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你用什么指标衡量团队处理事故的能力？
situation.en: Mainly mean time to recovery. Failures are inevitable, so what matters is how fast we restore service.

entries.note: 缩写 MTTR，逐个字母读。对应的“平均多久发现问题”是 mean time to detect（MTTD）。

entries.zh: 服务等级指标（实际测量值，缩写）

examples.en: Our main SLI is the percentage of requests that return successfully within 300 milliseconds.
examples.zh: 我们最主要的 SLI 是 300 毫秒内成功返回的请求占比。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你说可用性目标是 99.9%，那具体量的是什么？
situation.en: The SLI is the ratio of successful requests to total requests, measured at the edge.

entries.note: SLI 是测出来的数，SLO 是给这个数定的目标，SLA 是对外的合同承诺。

examples.en: We page someone only when the burn rate means we'd exhaust the error budget within hours.
examples.zh: 只有当消耗速率意味着几小时内就会耗尽错误预算时，我们才会呼叫值班的人。

situation.zh: 面试官问：基于服务等级目标的告警，具体怎么设？
situation.en: We alert on burn rate. A fast burn pages immediately, and a slow burn just opens a ticket.

entries.note: burn rate 为 1 表示正好在统计周期结束时用完预算，数值越大烧得越快。

entries.zh: 给代码埋点（加监控采集，动词短语）

examples.en: We instrumented the code with timers around every database call.
examples.zh: 我们给代码埋了点，在每次数据库调用前后都加了计时。

situation.zh: 同事说：这个函数到底慢在哪一步，现在完全看不出来。你建议：
situation.en: Let's instrument the code first, so we have real numbers instead of guesses.

entries.note: 名词是 instrumentation：add instrumentation。

examples.en: We lowered the trace sampling rate to one percent because storing every trace was too expensive.
examples.zh: 我们把链路的采样率降到了 1%，因为每条链路都存成本太高。

situation.zh: 同事问：为什么我在追踪系统里搜不到这个请求？
situation.en: It probably wasn't sampled. Our sampling rate is only five percent.

examples.en: Adding user ID as a metric label caused high cardinality and blew up our monitoring bill.
examples.zh: 把用户 ID 加成指标标签导致了高基数，监控账单直接爆了。

situation.zh: 同事想给每个指标都打上订单号标签。你想提醒：
situation.en: Order IDs are high cardinality, so that would create millions of time series. Let's put them in logs instead.

entries.note: cardinality 指一个字段不同取值的数量。高基数的数据适合放日志或链路，不适合当指标标签。

entries.zh: 开放授权协议（第三方登录常用，O 开头）

examples.en: We use OAuth so users can sign in with their Google account without sharing their password.
examples.zh: 我们用 OAuth，让用户可以用 Google 账号登录，而不用把密码交给我们。

situation.zh: 面试官问：第三方应用想访问用户在你们平台上的数据，怎么授权才安全？
situation.en: We'd support OAuth 2.0, so the user grants limited access and the third party never sees their credentials.

entries.note: 读作 /ˈoʊɔːθ/。OAuth 2.0 本身管的是授权，登录身份由建在它上面的 OpenID Connect（OIDC）负责。

examples.en: The access token expires after fifteen minutes, which limits the damage if it leaks.
examples.zh: 访问令牌十五分钟后过期，这样即使泄露，损失也有限。

situation.zh: 面试官问：客户端登录成功之后，后续请求怎么证明身份？
situation.en: It sends an access token in the Authorization header, and each service validates the signature.

entries.note: 常见格式是 JWT，可以逐个字母读，也有人读作 jot。

examples.en: When the access token expires, the client uses the refresh token to get a new one.
examples.zh: 访问令牌过期后，客户端用刷新令牌换一个新的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：访问令牌有效期这么短，用户岂不是要频繁重新登录？
situation.en: No, the client holds a longer-lived refresh token and exchanges it for a new access token in the background.

examples.en: When an employee leaves, we revoke all of their tokens and API keys the same day.
examples.zh: 员工离职时，我们会在当天吊销他所有的令牌和 API 密钥。

situation.zh: 用户反馈手机丢了，担心账号被人用。你说明你们会怎么处理：
situation.en: We can revoke every active session on that device, so whoever has the phone gets logged out.

entries.note: 名词是 revocation。无状态的 JWT 很难在过期前吊销，这是面试里常被追问的点。

examples.en: We use role-based access control, so permissions are assigned to roles rather than to individual users.
examples.zh: 我们用基于角色的访问控制，权限是分配给角色的，而不是直接分给个人。

situation.zh: 面试官问：后台有管理员、客服、财务三类人，权限怎么管？
situation.en: I'd go with role-based access control: define a role for each group and attach permissions to the role.

entries.note: 缩写 RBAC，读作 /ˈɑːrbæk/。

examples.en: The endpoint was vulnerable to SQL injection because it built the query by concatenating strings.
examples.zh: 这个接口有 SQL 注入漏洞，因为它是用字符串拼接来构造查询的。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里把用户输入直接拼进了查询语句。你想指出：
situation.en: This is open to SQL injection. Please pass the value as a parameter instead of concatenating it.

entries.note: SQL 可以逐个字母读，也可以读作 sequel。

examples.en: We only use parameterized queries, so user input is never interpreted as SQL.
examples.zh: 我们只用参数化查询，所以用户输入永远不会被当成 SQL 执行。

situation.zh: 面试官问：防止注入攻击，最根本的做法是什么？
situation.en: Use a parameterized query everywhere, so the database treats input strictly as data.

entries.note: 也叫 prepared statement。

examples.en: We escape all user-generated content before rendering it to prevent cross-site scripting.
examples.zh: 渲染之前我们会转义所有用户生成的内容，以防止跨站脚本攻击。

situation.zh: 面试官问：评论区允许用户输入富文本，有什么安全风险？
situation.en: The main risk is cross-site scripting, where an attacker injects a script that runs in other users' browsers.

entries.note: 缩写 XSS，逐个字母读。防御靠输出转义（escape output）和内容安全策略（CSP）。

examples.en: We protect state-changing endpoints against CSRF with a token and SameSite cookies.
examples.zh: 我们用令牌加 SameSite Cookie，防止修改状态的接口遭到 CSRF 攻击。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用 Cookie 保存登录态，别的网站能不能冒用用户身份发请求？
situation.en: That's a CSRF attack. We mitigate it with SameSite cookies and an anti-CSRF token on every form.

entries.note: 全称 cross-site request forgery。逐个字母读，也有人读作 sea-surf。

entries.zh: 清洗用户输入（动词短语，s 开头）

examples.en: We validate and sanitize user input on the server, because client-side checks can be bypassed.
examples.zh: 我们在服务端校验并清洗用户输入，因为客户端的检查是可以被绕过的。

situation.zh: 同事说：前端已经做过校验了，后端不用再管了吧？你回复：
situation.en: We still need to sanitize user input on the backend. Anyone can call the API directly.

entries.note: validate 是不合格就拒绝，sanitize 是把危险内容去掉或转义。

entries.zh: 密钥管理（密码、API 密钥等敏感配置）

examples.en: We moved all credentials out of the repo and into a secrets management service.
examples.zh: 我们把所有凭据都从代码仓库里挪了出去，放进了密钥管理服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：数据库密码、第三方 API 密钥，你们放在哪？
situation.en: They live in a secrets management system. Services fetch them at startup, and we rotate them regularly.

entries.note: secret 泛指密码、密钥、令牌等敏感值。定期更换叫 rotate：rotate the keys。把密钥写死在代码里叫 hard-code a secret。

examples.en: Every permission change is written to an audit log, so we can see who did what and when.
examples.zh: 每次权限变更都会写入审计日志，这样我们能查到谁在什么时候做了什么。

situation.zh: 安全团队问：如果有人偷偷导出了客户数据，你们能查出是谁吗？
situation.en: Yes, every export is recorded in an audit log that engineers can't modify or delete.

entries.note: 也叫 audit trail。audit 读 /ˈɔːdɪt/。
